description: Ranked directory of financial newswire sites that publish sell-side analyst price target press releases. Ordered by trust score and search engine reliability for discovering analyst reports on companies in our equity universe. Used by AI agents and fetch_analyst_targets.py to generate targeted source_url links.
usage_guidance: When generating source_url links for analyst price target records, use the top-ranked sites in site:-scoped Google search queries (e.g. 'site:thefly.com OR site:benzinga.com "Morgan Stanley" NVDA price target') to maximize the probability of linking to the actual press release article instead of generic search results.

sources.name: The Fly on the Wall
sources.access_model: Partial paywall - headlines and rating action summaries free, full text requires subscription
sources.strengths: Fastest real-time analyst call coverage in the market. Captures pre-market dispatches from every major Wall Street firm within minutes of release. Comprehensive coverage of upgrades, downgrades, initiations, and price target changes.
sources.weaknesses: Full article text requires paid subscription. Historical archive search can be limited for free users.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Google indexes TheFly headlines reliably. Analyst name + firm + ticker queries consistently surface relevant articles.

sources.name: Benzinga
sources.access_model: Freemium - most analyst coverage articles free, some premium features
sources.strengths: Excellent structured analyst ratings section per ticker. Good historical archive. Articles include analyst name, firm, previous target, new target, and rating action. Well-indexed by Google.
sources.weaknesses: Some articles behind Benzinga Pro paywall. Can include sponsored content alongside editorial.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Benzinga analyst articles are among the most reliably indexed by search engines. Structured per-ticker ratings pages make discovery straightforward.
sources.coverage_focus: US equities - all sectors, strong technology coverage

sources.name: StreetInsider
sources.access_model: Partial paywall - headlines and summaries free, full reports require subscription
sources.strengths: Dedicated analyst upgrades/downgrades news feed. Quick capture of rating changes. Clean article format with structured data (analyst, firm, price target, rating).
sources.weaknesses: Premium subscription required for full article access and historical archive.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Well-indexed by Google. Analyst rating articles surface reliably in search results.

sources.name: MarketBeat
sources.access_model: Freemium - basic analyst data free, premium analytics require subscription
sources.strengths: Structured per-ticker analyst forecast pages with tabular history. Source of our primary analyst target data via fetch_analyst_targets.py. Good historical record of individual analyst actions.
sources.weaknesses: Some data points require MarketBeat Premium. Analyst names sometimes generalized to 'Research Team'.
sources.search_reliability_notes: MarketBeat forecast pages rank highly in Google for '[TICKER] analyst price target' queries.

sources.name: TipRanks
sources.access_model: Freemium - basic consensus free, detailed analyst accuracy metrics require Premium
sources.strengths: Best platform for tracking individual analyst accuracy and success rates. Measures historical win rates and average returns per analyst. Provides analyst star rankings.
sources.weaknesses: Premium features required for full analyst profile access. Search indexing of individual articles can be inconsistent.
sources.search_reliability_notes: TipRanks consensus pages index well, but individual analyst action articles are less consistently indexed by Google.
sources.coverage_focus: US equities - all sectors, with analyst accountability metrics

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.access_model: Free with ads - most content freely accessible
sources.strengths: Broad distribution and high Google indexing. Aggregates analyst actions from newswires. Widely accessible without paywall barriers. Strong brand recognition.
sources.weaknesses: Analyst coverage articles are often aggregated from other sources (Reuters, PR Newswire) rather than original reporting. Can be delayed compared to dedicated financial newswires.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Yahoo Finance pages consistently rank in top Google results for financial queries. High domain authority.
sources.coverage_focus: US and global equities - all sectors

sources.name: Seeking Alpha
sources.access_model: Partial paywall - news headlines free, full analysis articles require Premium
sources.strengths: Good analyst coverage news section. Combines Wall Street analyst actions with community-driven investment analysis. Strong SEO presence.
sources.weaknesses: Premium subscription required for full article access. Mix of professional analyst coverage and retail investor opinions can require careful filtering.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Analyst rating news articles are well-indexed but sometimes behind paywall preview gates that limit Google snippet quality.

sources.name: Investing.com
sources.access_model: Free with ads - most content freely accessible
sources.strengths: Broad international coverage. Aggregates analyst opinions with structured tables. Good for cross-referencing consensus data across markets.
sources.weaknesses: Can be ad-heavy. Individual analyst action articles are often sourced from Reuters/AP rather than original reporting. URL slug patterns vary by ticker.
sources.search_reliability_notes: High domain authority ensures strong Google indexing. Analyst opinion pages rank well.

sources.name: Barron's / MarketWatch (Dow Jones)
sources.access_model: Paywall - full articles require Barron's or WSJ subscription
sources.strengths: High-quality original journalism on analyst actions. Detailed analysis of rating changes with market context. Strong editorial standards.
sources.weaknesses: Hard paywall significantly limits free access. Not ideal for systematic scraping or automated discovery.
sources.search_reliability_notes: Articles are well-indexed by Google but paywalled content limits snippet utility for verification.
sources.coverage_focus: US equities - large-cap focus, all sectors

sources.name: StockAnalysis.com
sources.access_model: Free - most data freely accessible with optional Pro tier
sources.strengths: Clean, modern layout. Free analyst consensus and price target data. Good historical forecast tracking. No aggressive paywall barriers.
sources.weaknesses: Aggregated data rather than original reporting. Individual analyst action dates can lag primary sources.
sources.search_reliability_notes: StockAnalysis.com forecast pages rank well for '[TICKER] analyst price target' queries. Clean URL structure aids discovery.
